title: date_extract: extract a date part (year, month, quarter, day, weekday) from a date column
description: Parse a date or datetime column and extract a specific time component into a new integer column. Supported parts: year, month, quarter, day, weekday (0=Monday). Use this before group_by when the user wants to analyse trends by year, month, or quarter.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: The date or datetime column to parse. Must exist in the dataset.

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: The date component to extract. Allowed values: year, month, quarter, day, weekday.

parameters.name: new_column
parameters.description: Name for the new integer column that will hold the extracted date part.

rag_note: date_extract uses pandas to_datetime to parse the column. If the column cannot be parsed as dates, an ExecutionError is raised. Weekday returns 0 for Monday and 6 for Sunday.
